verdict.rationale: Adyen documents payout schedule control (configurable payout frequency per merchant account, flexible payout timing/currency) and general reporting on balances, sales and payouts, plus platform-level splitting/fee-deduction before payout. However, the evidence lacks concrete documentation of a line-item reconciliation report that itemizes exactly which charges, fees, and refunds compose a specific payout. Missing for 10: detailed payout reconciliation/statement report showing per-transaction breakdown, independent/hands-on confirmation of reconciliation accuracy.
